name: BasicDAGColorErrors
text:
# BasicDAGColorErrors


## Overview
BasicDAGColorErrors provides a binary quality control mechanism for [sparse voxel DAG](#5984-sparse-voxel-dag.md) color data by computing an error flag between compressed and uncompressed color representations. It differs from sibling methods that may store continuous error metrics or skip validation by returning a strict binary indicator (1.0 or 0.0) based on a fixed threshold, ensuring adaptive quality control without storing additional floating-point error values per leaf.

## Shared principles
This family builds on [BasicDAGColorsBase](6742-basicdagcolorsbase.md), which decouples leaf count storage from the primary geometry data using an enclosed array structure. The core mechanism relies on the `enclosedLeaves` array to determine the number of leaves, which dictates the scope of the color error computation. The error calculation is performed per leaf, comparing the stored compressed color against a reference uncompressed color.

## Subtopics
This family does not define distinct subtopics; it serves as a specific implementation of the error checking protocol within the [BasicDAGColorsBase](#6742-basicdagcolorsbase.md) hierarchy.

## Background
The method originates from the HashDAG project by Phyronnaz [S1, unofficial]. It is used in the context of real-time [volume rendering optimization](#8167-dual-rendering-equation-optimization.md), specifically to validate the integrity of compressed color data during the rendering pipeline. The approach allows for efficient detection of [compression](#4-compression.md) artifacts or data corruption by triggering a binary flag when the error exceeds a predefined tolerance.

## Sources
[S1] Phyronnaz/HashDAG, https://github.com/Phyronnaz/HashDAG, fetched 2026-10-26 (unofficial)
